CASE ACCOUNT / POLICY ANALYSIS

INDEPENDENT PRACTICE / CAPE TOWN

When more thinking makes everything worse.

A senior policy analyst was weeks away from a major strategic review. Her research was strong. But the final report had stalled.

← Work & research
Print / Save as PDF ↗

DECISION FOCUS

The report’s
argument.

01 / THE PATTERN

Generate with AI. Over-edit. Rewrite. Repeat. Too many directions. No clear argument.

02 / THE INTERVENTION

We removed the tools. One question only: What is the argument this report must make—if everything else is stripped away?

03 / THE SHIFT

Clarity returned. AI became support—not noise. Whole sections were removed without hesitation.

REPORTED OUTCOME / CASE ACCOUNT

Final draft in 9 days.

“This is the first version that actually argues something.”

THE SPOTTED APE (PTY) LTD / CAPE TOWN, SOUTH AFRICA
